subject: E-Commerce
title: Amazon's Private Label Strategy
description: A 60-second lesson on Amazon's Private Label Strategy.

hook.text: Amazon sells 400+ private label brands compete directly with sellers on its own platform. It's the referee and a player.

buildup.text: Amazon Basics, Amazon Essentials, and Solimo are Amazon-owned brands that undercut top-selling third-party products.

discovery.text: Amazon uses seller data to identify best-selling products, then creates its own versions at lower prices.

twist.text: EU regulators fined Amazon for using seller data to advantage its own products.

climax.text: Amazon's dual role as marketplace and competing seller creates an inherent conflict regulators worldwide are addressing.

punchline.text: The goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: Why is Amazon's private label strategy controversial?
options: Amazon uses third-party seller data to create competing products on its own platform
